body_es: Destructuring permite extraer valores de arrays u objetos en variables individuales de forma concisa. La destructuring de arrays usa corchetes: const [a, b] = [1, 2]. Puedes omitir elementos: const [a, , c] = [1, 2, 3] ignora el segundo. La destructuring de objetos usa llaves: const { name, age } = person. Puedes renombrar propiedades: const { name: n, age: a } = person. El rest operator (...) captura elementos o propiedades restantes: const [a, ...rest] = [1, 2, 3, 4]. En funciones, destructuring simplifica acceder a parámetros: function greet({ name, age }) {}. Destructuring anidado permite trabajar con estructuras complejas. Es extremadamente útil en código moderno porque reduce la verbosidad. Destructuring hace código más legible y es una característica ES6 ampliamente usada.
body_en: Destructuring allows extracting values from arrays or objects into individual variables concisely. Array destructuring uses brackets: const [a, b] = [1, 2]. You can skip elements: const [a, , c] = [1, 2, 3] skips the second. Object destructuring uses braces: const { name, age } = person. You can rename properties: const { name: n, age: a } = person. The rest operator (...) captures remaining elements or properties: const [a, ...rest] = [1, 2, 3, 4]. In functions, destructuring simplifies accessing parameters: function greet({ name, age }) {}. Nested destructuring handles complex structures. It's extremely useful in modern code because it reduces verbosity. Destructuring makes code more readable and is a widely-used ES6 feature.
